description: Audit and enforce Servicemembers Civil Relief Act (50 U.S.C. § 3991) 6% delinquent property tax interest cap, strip unlawful county penalties, and issue stay of tax sale injunction.

billed_accrued_interest_and_penalties.description: Total accrued interest, penalties, and late charges billed by county

is_threatened_with_tax_sale.description: True if county has scheduled a delinquent tax foreclosure auction

months_delinquent_during_service.description: Number of months delinquency accrued during military service
